items.title: Local RAG memory system that AI can write directly to
items.raw_excerpt: For me and my family, it get really annoying having to reshare information each time you create a new LLM chat. Therefore, I decided to create local-memory-mcp, a local MCP that allows LLMs to read and write to a RAG. It also has built in systems that help keep the system efficient like a max chunk size and deprecation when information gets updated. I would love it if you all would try it out and let me know your thoughts. It's been a huge time and token saver for us. Thanks for the help and enjoy!

title_i18n.en: Local RAG memory system that AI can write directly to
title_i18n.zh: 本地RAG记忆系统，AI可直接写入
title_i18n.es: Sistema de memoria RAG local al que la IA puede escribir directamente.

excerpt_i18n.en: For me and my family, it get really annoying having to reshare information each time you create a new LLM chat. Therefore, I decided to create local-memory-mcp, a local MCP that allows LLMs to read and write to a RAG. It also has built in systems that help keep the system efficient like a max chunk size and deprecation when information gets updated. I would love it if you all would try it out and let me know your thoughts. It's been a huge time and token saver for us. Thanks for the help and enjoy!
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我和家人每次新建LLM对话时都得重新分享信息，这真的很烦人。因此，我决定创建local-memory-mcp，一个允许LLM读写RAG的本地MCP。
excerpt_i18n.es: Para mí y mi familia, resulta muy molesto tener que volver a compartir información cada vez que inicias un nuevo chat con un LLM. Por eso, decidí crear local-memory-mcp, un MCP local que permite a los LLMs leer y escribir en un RAG.

items.title: 德国数字化部长疑用AI写公文遭质疑
items.raw_excerpt: 德国数字化和国家现代化部长卡斯滕·维尔德贝格尔因疑使用人工智能（AI）工具完成演讲稿等多份公文，眼下遭到德国媒体和公众质疑。据德国《时代》周报13日报道，基于专门检测AI生成内容的软件进行的分析，多篇署名维尔德贝格尔的演讲稿和评论文章似乎主要由AI生成。报道说，以维尔德贝格尔的名义发表在德国主要报纸上的文章，以及多篇议会演讲，都显示出大量由AI辅助的迹象；其2024年在美国智库大西洋理事会发表的一篇演讲据信完全由AI生成。不过，一些专家指出，此类检测软件并不完全可信。数字化和国家现代化部一名发言人向德新社证实，维尔德贝格尔将AI作为辅助工作工具使用，称这一做法缘于“他坚信德国必须迅速学会以既高效又审慎的方式使用人工智能。这适用于经济、公共部门和政治领域”。

excerpt_i18n.en: German Minister for Digitalization and State Modernization, Carsten Wildberger, is facing scrutiny from German media and the public over suspicions that he used artificial intelligence (AI) tools to complete multiple official documents, including speeches. According to a report by the German weekly *Die Zeit* on the 13th, analysis based on software specifically designed to detect AI-generated content suggests that several speeches and commentary articles attributed to Wildberger appear to have been primarily generated by AI. The report stated that articles published in major German newspapers under Wildberger's name, as well as multiple parliamentary speeches, show significant signs of AI assistance. One speech delivered in 2024 at the U.S. think tank Atlantic Council is believed to have been entirely generated by AI. However, some experts have pointed out that such detection software is not entirely reliable. A spokesperson for the Ministry of Digitalization and State Modernization confirmed to the German Press Agency (dpa) that Wildberger uses AI as an auxiliary work tool, stating that this approach stems from "his firm belief that Germany must quickly learn to use artificial intelligence in both an efficient and prudent manner. This applies to the economy, the public sector, and politics."
excerpt_i18n.es: El ministro alemán de Digitalización y Modernización del Estado, Carsten Wildberger, está siendo cuestionado por los medios y el público alemán tras sospechas de haber utilizado herramientas de inteligencia artificial (IA) para redactar múltiples documentos oficiales, incluidos discursos. Según informó el semanario alemán *Die Zeit* el día 13, basándose en análisis realizados con software especializado en detectar contenido generado por IA, varios discursos y artículos de opinión firmados por Wildberger parecen haber sido mayoritariamente generados por IA. El informe señala que los artículos publicados en su nombre en los principales periódicos alemanes, así como varios discursos parlamentarios, muestran numerosos indicios de asistencia de IA; se cree que un discurso pronunciado en 2024 en el think tank estadounidense Atlantic Council fue completamente generado por IA. items.title: UK announces $1.5B AI infrastructure plan
items.raw_excerpt: The UK announced a £1.5 billion AI infrastructure plan, including funding for supercomputers and chips, to boost AI competitiveness and economic growth.

title_i18n.en: UK announces $1.5B AI infrastructure plan
title_i18n.zh: 英国宣布15亿美元人工智能基础设施计划
title_i18n.es: Reino Unido anuncia un plan de infraestructura de IA por 1.500 millones de dólares.

excerpt_i18n.en: The UK announced a £1.5 billion AI infrastructure plan, including funding for supercomputers and chips, to boost AI competitiveness and economic growth.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 英国政府宣布了一项15亿英镑的人工智能基础设施计划，包括投资建造超级计算机和芯片，以提升国家在AI领域的竞争力。该计划旨在支持科研和商业应用，推动经济增长。
